written.text: The Agreement has a term of three (3) years, commencing on 1 January 2026. Each party may terminate the Agreement for material breach upon thirty (30) days' written notice if the breach is not remedied.

The Licence Fee is EUR 120,000 per annum, as stated in the Agreement. Payment is required annually in advance and must be made within forty-five (45) days of the invoice date.  

The total liability of either party under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding any claim. Neither party is liable for loss of profit or indirect loss.  

This Agreement is governed by the laws of Sweden.

The limitation and exclusion of liability in the Agreement is set out as follows: "Neither party's total liability under this Agreement shall exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim". Additionally, "Neither party is liable for loss of profit or indirect loss".
